name: Trip Registration Receipt
description: Payment receipt sent to a participant after they register and pay for a trip
subject: Receipt for {trip_name} - £{amount_paid}
body_html:
Trip Registration Receipt

Dear {participant_name},

Thank you for registering for {trip_name}. Your payment has been received and your place is confirmed.

Trip details

Trip{trip_name}
Destination{destination}
Dates{trip_dates}
Registration{registration_reference}

Payment

Amount paid£{amount_paid}
Method{payment_method}
Reference{payment_reference}
Date{payment_date}

{balance_line}

Please keep this receipt for your records. If any of the details above are wrong, contact the trips office before the departure date.

{signature}

participant_name.description: Name of the person who registered

trip_dates.description: Trip dates, already formatted (a single date for single-day trips)

amount_paid.description: Amount paid, formatted to two decimal places without the currency symbol

payment_method.description: How the participant paid (Cash, Card, Student finance account)

balance_line.description: Remaining student finance account balance; blank for cash and card payments

separator.description: Visual separator for the text version

signature.description: Email signature; supplied by the renderer when omitted
